subject.title: feat(worktrees): configurable cleanup limits (max count, max total size) with Settings UI

question: Should OpenClaw core permanently expose both `worktrees.cleanup.maxCount` and `worktrees.cleanup.maxTotalSizeGb` through configuration and the Control UI?
rationale: The implementation is coherent, but repository policy gives new configuration surface a high bar, and automation cannot decide whether two permanent retention controls are the desired long-term product contract.

options.title: Approve both opt-in limits
options.body: Accept count and total-size settings as the core retention contract, then require real-Gateway proof before merge.

options.title: Narrow the policy surface
options.body: Consolidate the retention policy into fewer controls before publishing a permanent configuration contract.

options.title: Keep time-based cleanup
options.body: Decline the new settings and retain idle cleanup plus explicit manual garbage collection.

recommendation.title: Approve both opt-in limits
recommendation.body: Accept count and total-size settings as the core retention contract, then require real-Gateway proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: They own the proposal and every branch commit and are the closest evidenced participant for this exact product-contract decision.
